data.name: Image.Integrity.IsoTruncated
data.value: The ISO image is cut off: its volume descriptor announces {0:N0} bytes, the file has {1:N0}.

data.name: Image.Integrity.UdfTruncated
data.value: The UDF file system is cut off: {0:N0} bytes are expected, {1:N0} are present.

data.name: Image.Integrity.PartitionBeyondEnd
data.value: Partition {0} extends to byte {1:N0}, but the image is only {2:N0} bytes long.

data.name: Image.Integrity.GptBackupMissing
data.value: The backup GPT at the end is missing: the image would have to be at least {0:N0} bytes, it is only {1:N0}.

data.name: Image.Integrity.GptHeaderInvalid
data.value: The checksum of the GPT header does not match.

data.name: Image.Integrity.WimTruncated
data.value: The WIM file is cut off: its header refers to byte {0:N0}, the file has only {1:N0} bytes.

data.name: Image.Integrity.VhdFooterMissing
data.value: The footer of the VHD file is missing; the file is incomplete.

data.name: Image.Integrity.CompressedIncomplete
data.value: The compressed file ({0}) is incomplete or damaged: {1}

data.name: Image.Integrity.CompressedUnverified
data.value: The {0} format has no end marker; whether the file is complete only shows when it is decompressed in full.

data.name: Image.Integrity.PartialDownload
data.value: The file extension "{0}" marks an unfinished download.

data.name: Image.Integrity.ImageOnTarget
data.value: The image is stored on the target disk and would be overwritten while it is being written.

data.name: Image.Warning.CompressedSizeUnknown
data.value: The decompressed size is unknown because the format does not store it; the space check is therefore only an estimate.

data.name: Image.Warning.AnalysisPartial
data.value: Only the first {0} MiB of the decompressed image were examined; the file list and family may be incomplete.

data.name: Image.Warning.FileTreeIncomplete
data.value: The file structure of the image could not be read completely.

data.name: Image.Warning.FileSystemUnreadable
data.value: The file system of the image could not be read; the detection is based on the header only.

data.name: Image.Warning.WimUnreadable
data.value: The Windows image file "{0}" could not be read; edition, build and architecture are unknown.

data.name: Image.Warning.Win7EfiLoaderMissing
data.value: The image contains bootmgr.efi but no UEFI loader under \EFI\BOOT. For UEFI boot, bootmgfw.efi has to be copied from install.wim (index 1) as bootx64.efi.

data.name: Image.Warning.BootImageUnreadable
data.value: The El Torito boot image could not be read.

data.name: Image.Warning.NotBootable
data.value: The image contains neither boot files nor boot code and is probably not bootable.

data.name: Image.Warning.Sector4kImage
data.value: The partition table was written for 4096-byte sectors and only fits disks with 4Kn sectors.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.VendorMandatesRawCopy
data.value: The vendor requires a raw (DD) write; ISO mode is known to be broken for this system.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.IsoModeOnly
data.value: This system only boots from extracted files; a raw write does not work.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.NotBootableAsDisk
data.value: The image has no partition table (it is not a hybrid image) and cannot be written directly; its files have to be extracted.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.RawImageOnly
data.value: Raw disk images are always written directly.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.HybridRawCopy
data.value: Hybrid image: a raw write is the most reliable method and leaves the image untouched.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.PersistenceNeedsExtract
data.value: ISO mode is used for persistence because a raw copy of the image has no writable partition.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.PersistenceViaPartition
data.value: Persistence is provided as an additional partition behind the raw copy of the image.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.WindowsSetupExtract
data.value: Windows media are not disk images; the files are copied and the disk is made bootable.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.WindowsStickRawCopy
data.value: The image already is a bootable disk and is written directly.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.WimApplied
data.value: WIM files are applied to the disk by the Windows layer.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.DataImageAsk
data.value: The image contains no boot data: should its files be copied or the image written raw?

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.FloppyImageRawCopy
data.value: Floppy and superfloppy images are written raw.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.PreferredModeUsed
data.value: The write mode you chose is used.

data.name: Image.Policy.Reason.PreferredModeRefused
data.value: The write mode you chose does not work with this image; the recommended method is used instead.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.DdReadOnlyLayout
data.value: A raw write puts the read-only ISO layout on the disk: Windows may offer to format it afterwards (decline), and the remaining space is not usable. "Restore disk" brings back the normal state.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.GptBackupAtIsoEnd
data.value: After a raw write the backup GPT sits at the end of the ISO area, not at the end of the disk.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.UefiOnlyEdk2
data.value: The image has an EFI boot entry but no EFI system partition: UEFI boot only works on EDK2-based firmware.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.GptProtectiveMbrLegacy
data.value: GPT with a protective MBR can fail to boot on some older BIOS machines. Choose ISO mode with MBR for old devices.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.Sector4kTarget
data.value: The target disk has 4096-byte sectors while the image's partition table assumes 512-byte sectors; the image will not boot reliably there.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.SuperfloppyUnreliable
data.value: Writing a floppy image to a USB stick as a superfloppy does not work on every BIOS; legacy/CSM boot only.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.LabelChanged
data.value: The label "{0}" does not fit on FAT and becomes "{1}"; the boot configuration is adjusted accordingly.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.FatFileLimit
data.value: The image contains files of 4 GiB or more, which FAT32 cannot hold. Choose another file system or use raw mode.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.NtfsExfatHelper
data.value: NTFS and exFAT need a helper driver (UEFI:NTFS) for UEFI boot, and the system's boot loader and initramfs have to be able to read the file system.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.CasperExfat
data.value: Ubuntu and relatives cannot find the live medium on exFAT. Choose FAT32 or NTFS.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.BootloaderOffline
data.value: The boot loader files (Syslinux, GRUB) have to match the version in the image; without internet the embedded version is used or a raw write is chosen instead.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.LegacyBiosOnly
data.value: This image only boots in the legacy/CSM mode of the BIOS.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.BsdIsoForOptical
data.value: BSD ISO images are meant for optical media; for USB sticks use the "memstick" or "install...img" image.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.NotBootableOnPc
data.value: This image is made for single-board computers (ARM) and does not boot on a PC.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.RevokedLoaders
data.value: Some of the contained boot loaders are revoked and may not start with Secure Boot enabled; turn Secure Boot off for this boot.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.PersistenceUnsupported
data.value: Persistence is not possible for this image.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.PersistenceBootArgument
data.value: Persistence is only used when the kernel parameter "persistence" is given at boot (Kali has a menu entry for it).

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.ImageLargerThanTarget
data.value: The image needs {0:N0} bytes, the disk offers only {1:N0} bytes.

data.name: Image.Policy.Warning.EsxiSyslinux
data.value: ESXi boots through Syslinux; "-p 1" has to be added to the configuration so that the installer finds its files on the first partition.
